title: TOC Semio Window Tables
summary: Made TOC and other register tables (glossary, references, list-of-*) visually consistent with Window tables like Netzwerk: longtable register tables now use padded left/right vertical rules via pipe colspec, bottom closing rule on last page, continuation chrome with two-arg window gap and matching bordered multicolumn. Removed obsolete register@long flag/toggles; glossary now uses the same long bordered path. Fixed broken \semio@window@gap{semio-chrome-base} call in continuation chrome (pre-existing two-arg signature). Verified zwischenbericht light+dark build (12 pages), TOC on pages 2-3, glossary on page 12.
